meta.title: Event reasoning — CatalogueEntryAvailabilityView
meta.description:
## Event → field reasoning — CatalogueEntryAvailabilityView

Same 8-event wide fan-in as AvailableCopiesCountView (CopyAdded/CopyReserved/CopyCheckedOut/CopyReturned/CopyReservationReleased/CopySentForRepair/CopyReturnedFromRepair/CopyReportedLost), rolled up per titleId into a single `availabilityLabel` field (e.g. '2 of 3 available'). Kept as its own read model rather than reused from AvailableCopiesCountView because it is scoped per-title (List) rather than library-wide (Single) — a different query shape, not just a different consumer. Reused by both Catalogue Browse and Book Details.
